mentions.name: Live report map
mentions.description: A small live map where everyone sees new reports pop in as they happen in real time, built on Supabase's realtime channels rather than a custom socket layer.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just shipped a little live map where everyone sees new reports pop in as they happen — I went with Supabase's realtime channels because I didn't trust myself to run my own socket layer
mentions.author: mikeshadpour
